sources.title: Independent scalar probability/log derivation
sources.details: p=exp(2)/(exp(2)+2), ln p=2-ln(exp(2)+2). Two scored targets give 2 ln p and exp(2 ln p)=p²; three give 3 ln p and (3 ln p)/3=ln p. Units are nats for sum, nats/scored token for mean; float32 execution tolerance ≤3e−7, four-decimal rounding ±0.00005.
